description: Rodinia K-means clustering. Faithful port: the original invert_mapping (row-major to feature-major inversion for coalesced loads) and kmeansPoint (nearest-center assignment) kernels; the inverted feature-major layout is preserved. tex1Dfetch on the inverted features is replaced by __ldg (portability substitution). Cluster centers live in constant memory; centroid sums are done on the CPU each iteration. Centroids re-init per pass so every pass runs identical work.

scaling_param.name: points
scaling_param.description: Number of data points to cluster

non_scaling_params.name: features
non_scaling_params.description: Number of features per data point (constant-memory limit: clusters*features <= 1088)

non_scaling_params.name: max_iter
non_scaling_params.description: K-means assignment iterations per timed pass

non_scaling_params.name: threads_per_block
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block; fixed at THREADS_PER_DIM^2=256 in the original geometry
